question: How many claims did we have in New York each month in the first half of 2026?

report.interpretation: Number of claims (auto and home) with a New York policy state, counted by loss date, for each month from January to June 2026. This uses the agreed claim_count metric. All six months are well past the reporting lag, so they are essentially complete.
report.answer: New York claims by loss month in H1 2026: Jan 21, Feb 39, Mar 37, Apr 49, May 42, Jun 40. That is 228 claims in total. January is noticeably lower than the other months. I did not investigate why.
report.answer_sql: SELECT CAST(date_trunc('month', loss_date) AS DATE) AS month, count(*) AS claims FROM claims WHERE state='NY' AND loss_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-01-01' AND DATE '2026-06-30' GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY ALL

tool_calls.sql:
WITH source AS (
    SELECT c.*, p.channel, p.metro,
           coalesce(pay.paid, 0) AS paid_to_date,
           coalesce(pay.paid, 0) + c.reserve_amount AS incurred,
           c.close_date - c.report_date AS days_to_close
    FROM claims c
    JOIN policies p USING (policy_id)
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT claim_id, sum(amount) AS paid FROM claim_payments GROUP BY claim_id
    ) pay USING (claim_id)
)
SELECT CAST(date_trunc('month', loss_date) AS DATE) AS period, count(*) AS value
FROM source
WHERE loss_date >= DATE '2026-01-01'
  AND loss_date <= DATE '2026-06-30'
  AND state IN ('NY')
GROUP BY ALL
ORDER BY ALL
